title: GridMap food court and pawn shop
summary: Walk south from the casino to eat, sit in a booth or visit Rusty Hogg's pawn shop.
notes: Build covered food-court and pawn-shop rooms with GridMap floors, wood panels and doorway headers.
Restore the food court's 32 seats and food counters alongside the pawn shop's existing sales and loot counter.
Connect both shops to the casino through a four-metre-wide south corridor.
